page.notes: Left margin: the scan edge and a fold cut through it, so only a few margin words are legible. Those I could read are given as notes; the rest are not transcribed. Doubtful readings: the running head's first letter is cut off by the scan edge (marked [?]); "posit" in the Ecclesiasticum entry; "ut" at the start of the Beate entry; "21." in the Græcis entry; the start of the Bisextum, Bonis and Ceterorum lines is cut off; "singulas" in the Bonorum entry; "heredibus" and "opor-[?]ot" in the Horum entry; "Prætor" and "[?]erfamilias" are partly hidden at line ends. The word "[?]erfamilias" is probably paterfamilias. Hyphenated line-end words are kept with their printed hyphens.
